description.en: A fossil false trunk consists of numerous small stems embedded in a root mass.
description.zh: 化石假干由根群包埋的许多小茎组成。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Tempskya, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Tempskya 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: A many-stem cross-section differs structurally from the single-stem root mantle of Psaronius.
distinctness.zh: 多茎横截面在结构上区别于Psaronius的单干根套。

modeling_brief.en: Use one cut false-trunk specimen with uneven rounded stem islands and interwoven root bands; no added living crown.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作单件切面假干标本，以不规则小茎岛和交织根带表现，不添加活体树冠。

uncertainty: Living outline and leaf arrangement are uncertain; specimen is the intended representation.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
